title: Nonconvergence of the normalized size of the second remainder set
author: Xiaojian Zeng
scope: Exactly the accepted j=2 nonconvergence theorem, its two all-t inequalities and its t>=203 separation; no higher iterates or exact global extrema.

user_library_citations.support: Section 6: exact predicates, complete finite coverage and a separate standard-library verification implementation. Used as a methodological comparison, not a remainder-set theorem.
